prompt:
I lied… It’s not next month. It’s now.
I lied… It’s not next month.
You’re brave, you hear me? If I’m gone — you’ll manage.
What should I call her?
Name her…

The house with blue shutters. By the well. Mom wrote about it.
Grandma, this is Noah. He doesn’t remember.
Anna.
Anna. Her name is Anna.
“Simon promised. Saturday night he’ll take us away. Noah has already packed his backpack.”
Noah… It’s me. It’s Iris.
It’s twenty kilometers to the cabin. Through the woods.

…Annie.
I was. Until your father forbade it.
Water on the stove. Clean sheets are in the chest.
I know. Somebody did that to him.
I can’t do this without light. There’s a generator in the shed, but no gas. Gas is at the store — Pyotr’s place.
Press here! Harder!
The lake doesn’t let its own go, dear. Whoever drowns stays with it. And its anger lives in whoever saw.
Your mother lives in you. She’s the one who kept Iris safe.
The doctor… She came to me, you know. A week before. Said: Mom, I’m leaving him. And I told her: go see the doctor, he’s an educated man, he’ll help.
I sent her to him myself.
You’ll find out. Everyone does, at the lake.
Give me his poison.
Drink. You’ll sleep soundly.
You look so much like him right now. Like your father.
Stubborn. Like her.
Drink. You’ll sleep soundly.
Stubborn. Like her.
That was her.
That’s Annie singing.
It’s him. He came back then too. After Annie.

Are you our grandmother?
There’s a woman in labor. Help us.
The doctor said it’s an illness.
It’s an illness. I need treatment.
So… Mom is with me?
I don’t know.
Wait. I made you a promise — and broke it. I’m sorry.
Go. I won’t stop you.
There’s a car at the edge of the village. Black. Headlights off.
Don’t go to the lake alone.
